study type: Secondary analysis of a cohort study
exposure: Birthweight category according to each chart
Different birthweight charts (Intergrowth-21st, WHO-Fetal Growth Charts, Birth in Brazil population chart, and GROW-customised chart)
finding: Populational and customised birthweight charts detected different prevalences of small-for-gestational-age neonates but showed similar and poor performance in identifying related neonatal adverse outcomes in nulliparas.
mod_finding: Women delivering SGA neonates had a significantly lower risk of caesarean sections compared to those delivering adequate-for-gestational-age neonates.
